answer_1.quote: We implement WriteHERE on two distinct long-form writing tasks: technical report generation and narrative generation. ... Experiments on the TELL ME A STORY dataset for fiction writing and the WildSeek dataset for structured document generation demonstrate significant improvements.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form narratives and technical reports (stories, structured reports up to 10,000+ words)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the LLM-based evaluator for story assessment ... The Davidson model effectively handles cases with ties. ... Scores on WildSeek in this section is produced with the opensourced evaluator LLM Prometheus 2 which is shown to have high agreement with the proprietary LM judges.

answer_3.quote: We use Gemini (2.0-Flash) as the base LLM for the evaluator ... Scores on WildSeek ... produced with the opensourced evaluator LLM Prometheus 2 ... We also employ o1-preview as our primary evaluator model for report metrics.

answer_4.quote: We recruited five volunteer annotators with qualified technical backgrounds to compare reports generated by WriteHERE against a state-of-the-art commercial baseline. Each annotator provided absolute scores on a 1-5 scale for all five dimensions and indicated their overall preference.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to evaluate the generated reports based on detailed guidelines, assigning scores for Relevance, Breadth, Depth, Novelty, and Clarity, and to select which report they preferred overall.
